e.summary: 风险导向组合构建（CRAN 2.1.8，2026-08 更新）：ERC/风险预算等 Ardia 等原版实现
e.summary_en: Risk-based portfolio construction (CRAN 2.1.8, updated 2026-08): ERC, risk budgeting and more, by Ardia et al.
e.summary_hk: 風險導向組合構建（CRAN 2.1.8，2026-08 更新）：ERC/風險預算等 Ardia 等原版實現
e.body:
RiskPortfolios（CRAN 2.1.8，2026-08-21 更新；作者 David Ardia、Kris Boudt、Jean-Philippe Gagnon-Fleury）实现**风险导向（risk-based）组合构建**方法族：等风险贡献（ERC）、风险预算、最小方差等，用 quadprog 做凸优化、nloptr 做非线性求解。方法出自 Ardia et al. (2017, Annals of Operations Research) 与 JOSS 短文，是这一支文献的**作者原版实现**。对 RIAA：保险公司资产端的标准开源工具——与 [[riskfolio-lib]]（Python 侧同类实现，功能更宽）和 [[qarm]]（Solvency II 组合优化器）互补；组合构建完成后的集中度与相关性诊断可接 [[concentrationmetrics]] 与 [[correlationmatrix]]；偿付能力资本的市场风险模块、ALM 与风险预算讨论都常用这套视角；适合投资风险、ALM 与偿付能力方向。

## 同类工具
[[risky-router]]、[[rna-r3s]]、[[security-decision-labs]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
RiskPortfolios (CRAN 2.1.8, updated 2026-08-21; authors David Ardia, Kris Boudt, Jean-Philippe Gagnon-Fleury) implements the **risk-based portfolio construction** family: equal risk contribution (ERC), risk budgeting, minimum variance and more, using quadprog for convex optimisation and nloptr for nonlinear solving. The methods come from Ardia et al. (2017, Annals of Operations Research) and a JOSS paper — this is the **authors’ own implementation** of that literature. For RIAA: a standard open-source tool on the insurance asset side — complementary to [[riskfolio-lib]] (the broader Python counterpart) and [[qarm]] (Solvency II portfolio optimiser); post-construction concentration and correlation diagnostics connect to [[concentrationmetrics]] and [[correlationmatrix]]; market-risk modules of solvency capital, ALM and risk-budgeting discussions all draw on this perspective; suits investment risk, ALM and solvency work.

## Similar tools
[[risky-router]]、[[rna-r3s]]、[[security-decision-labs]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
RiskPortfolios（CRAN 2.1.8，2026-08-21 更新；作者 David Ardia、Kris Boudt、Jean-Philippe Gagnon-Fleury）實現**風險導向（risk-based）組合構建**方法族：等風險貢獻（ERC）、風險預算、最小方差等，用 quadprog 做凸優化、nloptr 做非線性求解。方法出自 Ardia et al. (2017, Annals of Operations Research) 與 JOSS 短文，是這一支文獻的**作者原版實現**。對 RIAA：保險公司資產端的標準開源工具——與 [[riskfolio-lib]]（Python 側同類實現，功能更寬）和 [[qarm]]（Solvency II 組合優化器）互補；組合構建完成後的集中度與相關性診斷可接 [[concentrationmetrics]] 與 [[correlationmatrix]]；償付能力資本的市場風險模組、ALM 與風險預算討論都常用這套視角；適合投資風險、ALM 與償付能力方向。

## 同類工具
